components.name: StatusGlyphComponent
components.templateData:
@if (status) {
  <svg
    class="status-glyph"
    [attr.data-status]="status.toLowerCase()"
    [ngSwitch]="status"
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    viewBox="0 0 32 32"
    width="22"
    height="22"
    aria-hidden="true">

    <!-- Backlog: hex outline only -->
    <ng-container *ngSwitchCase="LibraryStatus.Backlog">
      <polygon
        points="16,4 26,10 26,22 16,28 6,22 6,10"
        fill="none"
        stroke="currentColor"
        stroke-width="1.5" />
    </ng-container>

    <!-- Playing: outer outline + filled inner hex -->
    <ng-container *ngSwitchCase="LibraryStatus.Playing">
      <polygon
        points="16,4 26,10 26,22 16,28 6,22 6,10"
        fill="none"
        stroke="currentColor"
        stroke-width="1.5" />
      <polygon
        points="16,11 22,14.5 22,21.5 16,25 10,21.5 10,14.5"
        fill="currentColor" />
    </ng-container>

    <!-- Played: outline + bottom-half fill via clipPath -->
    <ng-container *ngSwitchCase="LibraryStatus.Played">
      <defs>
        <clipPath id="played-bottom-half">
          <rect x="0" y="16" width="32" height="12" />
        </clipPath>
      </defs>
      <polygon
        points="16,4 26,10 26,22 16,28 6,22 6,10"
        fill="none"
        stroke="currentColor"
        stroke-width="1.5" />
      <polygon
        points="16,4 26,10 26,22 16,28 6,22 6,10"
        fill="currentColor"
        clip-path="url(#played-bottom-half)" />
    </ng-container>

    <!-- Finished: filled hex + dark checkmark -->
    <ng-container *ngSwitchCase="LibraryStatus.Finished">
      <polygon
        points="16,4 26,10 26,22 16,28 6,22 6,10"
        fill="currentColor" />
      <polyline
        points="11,16 14.5,19.5 21,13"
        fill="none"
        class="status-glyph__check"
        stroke-width="2.2"
        stroke-linecap="round"
        stroke-linejoin="round" />
    </ng-container>

    <!-- Completed: filled hex + dark checkmark + outer brass ring -->
    <ng-container *ngSwitchCase="LibraryStatus.Completed">
      <!-- outer brass ring -->
      <polygon
        points="16,1 28,8 28,24 16,31 4,24 4,8"
        fill="none"
        class="status-glyph__ring"
        stroke-width="1.5" />
      <!-- inner filled hex -->
      <polygon
        points="16,5 25,10.5 25,21.5 16,27 7,21.5 7,10.5"
        fill="currentColor" />
      <polyline
        points="11,16 14.5,19.5 21,13"
        fill="none"
        class="status-glyph__check"
        stroke-width="2.2"
        stroke-linecap="round"
        stroke-linejoin="round" />
    </ng-container>

    <!-- Abandoned: right half solid, left half dashed + faded -->
    <ng-container *ngSwitchCase="LibraryStatus.Abandoned">
      <polyline
        points="16,4 26,10 26,22 16,28"
        fill="none"
        stroke="currentColor"
        stroke-width="1.5"
        stroke-linecap="round"
        stroke-linejoin="round" />
      <polyline
        points="16,28 6,22 6,10 16,4"
        fill="none"
        stroke="currentColor"
        stroke-width="1.5"
        stroke-linecap="round"
        stroke-linejoin="round"
        stroke-dasharray="1.5 3"
        opacity="0.5" />
    </ng-container>

    <ng-container *ngSwitchDefault />
  </svg>
}
